summary: The meeting focused on finalizing the Case Metric (CAS) matrix definitions, specifically addressing Level 1 and Level 2 metrics outlined in Section 6. Participants agreed to defer resolving specific technical questions to the post-meeting discussion list rather than making immediate decisions, allowing time for deeper analysis. The team confirmed that the updated draft, which incorporates feedback on motivation, problem clarification, and the CAS layering model, is ready for submission to the ISG review pending further comments.
